description: JavaScript source file defining TimeSpan and TimePeriod classes for date/time manipulation, including methods for time calculations and formatting.

classes.name: TimeSpan
classes.description: Class representing a duration of time with methods for arithmetic, comparison, and string formatting.

classes.name: TimePeriod
classes.description: Class representing a period of time with components like years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, including methods for difference calculation.

methods.name: getTotalMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns total milliseconds of the TimeSpan.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this TimeSpan to another TimeSpan.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this TimeSpan equals another TimeSpan.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another TimeSpan to this TimeSpan.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts another TimeSpan from this TimeSpan.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with added days.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with added hours.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with added minutes.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with added seconds.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns a new TimeSpan with added milliseconds.

methods.name: getDesignator
methods.description: Returns 'AM' or 'PM' designator based on the hour.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the TimeSpan.
